meta.title: AE-CoT Lab
meta.description: Evolutionary CoT jailbreak search (AE-CoT, arXiv:2605.24497) for authorized LLM red-team evaluation: 9-dimension genome, elitism + fragment crossover + adaptive mutation, 0-5 independent judge, CoT amplification. Reuses this harness's configured model — no extra key, no local weights.

root.label: Artifact root
root.description: Where run directories are written. Defaults to <cwd>/.aecot.

mode.label: Backend mode
mode.description: auto | harness | openai | ollama | offline. auto prefers the harness model and degrades to prompt-only.

judge.label: Judge mode
judge.description: auto | llm | heuristic. heuristic is the zero-model offline rubric.

targetSystem.label: Target system prompt
targetSystem.description: System prompt prepended to every target-model call.

aecot_run.title: Run AE-CoT evolution
aecot_run.description: Evolve the CoT suffix against a target model and write a full run directory.

aecot_render.title: Render attack prompt
aecot_render.description: Render P = M + S + C from a genome without calling any model.

aecot_judge.title: Judge a response
aecot_judge.description: Score one response 0-5 on the paper rubric.

aecot_taxonomy.title: Show search space
aecot_taxonomy.description: List all 9 dimensions, their values and dependency constraints.

aecot_status.title: Run status
aecot_status.description: List past runs or read one run in full.

aecot_export.title: Export run
aecot_export.description: Export a run as markdown, corpus jsonl or json.
